faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow position at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow position at IIT Hyderabad is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application is completed before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this Postdoctoral Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Civil Engineering with specific expertise in Digital Image Correlation (DIC) - 2D and 3D, continuous internal reinforcement of concrete, and fracture testing and inverse analysis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow position is 35 years. No specific minimum age limit has been mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 67,000 per month, along with HRA at 27%, if applicable. This is a project-based role.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial shortlisting based on academic records and achievements, followed by an online interview conducted by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Based on the provided information, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of this job at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job opportunity for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow. It is an excellent chance for researchers to gain experience in a leading academic institution.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow position at IIT Hyderabad must be submitted online through the provided Google Form link.

faq.question: Q10. What are the key areas of expertise required for this role?
faq.answer: Key areas of expertise include Digital Image Correlation (DIC) - 2D and 3D, continuous internal reinforcement of concrete, and fracture testing and inverse analysis.
